* The flood in Germany turns out to be less severe than expected in the last few days. Exception is [[Wertheim am Main]], where a 100-year-high is expected.
* [[Tel Aviv central bus station massacre]]: A double [[suicide bombing]] shatters a busy area of [[Tel Aviv]], [[Israel]]. 23 people are killed and about 100 are wounded. Both the [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad|Islamic Jihad]] and [[Hamas]] claim to be responsible for the double bombing.
* [[Roy Jenkins]] dies.
